book.Title: &WEspers, Starapples, and Honey
book.page:
Oh. Yes.
I thought you should know? That there is a powerful esper. On the other side of that door.
I will go first. To reflect the attack.
Then we can camp, and... ah. I am thinking about starapples and honey. I would like you to cook that, when we make camp. Yes?
Hm? Oh. Yes. The powerful esper. I will go and kill them.
And then. Starapples and honey.
